takeaways: An enterprise agent needs three pillars: a trigger, tools and actions, and clean, well-tagged knowledge sources rather than decades of unfiltered SharePoint content.

Governance, DLP and a Center of Excellence should be in place before agents roll out, with policies scoped to what each agent actually needs and tools like Agent 365 providing inventory and observability.
The return on AI agents depends mostly on adoption, so every user needs role-based training on what an agent does and what input it expects.
hook: Building an impressive agent demo is easy, but making agents work reliably in a global enterprise with sensitive data, governance and real users is something else. Microsoft MVP Manpreet Singh explains for architects, IT leaders and makers how to design Copilot Studio agents with clean knowledge, human in the loop, governance, observability and the adoption work that finally delivers ROI.
